A Quick Note About WhatsApp Privacy

We love keeping you in the loop with our WhatsApp updates, but it’s worth mentioning that in a WhatsApp group, phone numbers of participants are visible to other members.

We completely understand if this isn’t ideal for everyone. If you have concerns, feel free to contact us directly or leave the group – no hard feelings! We’re always here to help.
